column1: ## Repository Table R4. Reference haplotype coverage

## Description: Coverage of reference SNV-haplotype hashes in 100 kb windows by a diagnostic UK Biobank subset. Frequency is a fraction, not percent; abundance-weighted and distinct-haplotype coverage have different denominators. These are not coverage fractions of all globally deduplicated 1,024 bp training strings.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | Target | Target for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 2 | Minimum reference haplotype frequency | Minimum reference haplotype frequency for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Abundance-weighted coverage | Abundance-weighted coverage for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 4 | Distinct-haplotype coverage | Distinct-haplotype coverage for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 5 | N reference haplotypes above threshold | N reference haplotypes above threshold for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 6 | Reference weight above threshold | Reference weight above threshold for the observation defined in the table description.
